architecture.mechanism: Shared AC-side filtering inductor as part of LCC compensation topology to reduce component count and volume
architecture.intervention: Redesign the QI charger pad receiver circuit to integrate the AC-side filtering inductor into an LCC compensation topology, sharing it with the power conversion stage to minimize resistive losses and component density.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced thermal generation due to lower component count and optimized power density, preventing excessive heat during charging.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure surface temperature of the modified QI charger pad under maximum load conditions and compare it against the original design; failure occurs if temperature exceeds safety thresholds or if charging efficiency drops below 85%.
